python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
base=Path('253/UQ-1')
index=base/'UQ-1.md'
text=index.read_text()
links=re.findall(r'<(Prerequisites/[^>]+\.md)>', text)
files=[base/p for p in links]
print(f'linked files: {len(files)}')
for f in files:
    if not f.exists():
        print('MISSING', f)

for f in files:
    lines=f.read_text().splitlines()
    inquiz=False
    qid=None
    qlabel=None
    i=0
    while i < len(lines):
        line=lines[i]
        if line.strip()=='```quiz':
            inquiz=True
            qid=None
        elif inquiz and line.strip()=='```':
            inquiz=False
        elif inquiz and line.startswith('id: '):
            qid=line.split(':',1)[1].strip()
        elif inquiz and line=='content: |-':
            start=i+1
            content=[]
            j=start
            while j < len(lines):
                if lines[j].startswith('options:') or lines[j].strip()=='```':
                    break
                if lines[j].startswith('  '):
                    content.append(lines[j][2:])
                else:
                    break
                j+=1
            body='\n'.join(content)
            has_inline = any(('$' in c and '$$' not in c) or ('∫' in c) for c in content)
            if has_inline:
                # show compact first line(s)
                compact=' / '.join(c.strip() for c in content if c.strip())
                print(f'{f}:{i+1}: {qid}: {compact[:220]}')
            i=j-1
        i+=1

from pathlib import Path

    qid=None
    i=0
    while i < len(lines):
        line=lines[i]
        if line.strip()=='```quiz':
            inquiz=True
            qid=None
        elif inquiz and line.strip()=='```':
            inquiz=False
        elif inquiz and line.startswith('id: '):
            qid=line.split(':',1)[1].strip()
        elif inquiz and line=='content: |-':
            content=[]
            j=i+1
            while j < len(lines):
                if lines[j].startswith('options:') or lines[j].strip()=='```':
                    break
                if lines[j].startswith('  '):
                    content.append(lines[j][2:])
                else:
                    break
                j+=1
            body='\n'.join(content)
            if '∫' in body or re.search(r'\$[^$]*\\int', body):
                compact=' / '.join(c.strip() for c in content if c.strip())
                print(f'{f}:{i+1}: {qid}: {compact[:220]}')
            i=j-1
        i+=1

        elif inquiz and line.strip()=='```':
